title: started this in Nanogram, rebuilt it with Claude Code: snakes & ladders where you place the snakes yourself
author: maziminds
selftext:
Classic snakes & ladders is pure luck based, you just roll the dice and hope for the best. so i made Climb & Bite, where the board starts empty and players build it. half the tiles have a ladder or snake to pick up, and on your turn you can place it before you roll. your snake can hurt others but yourself too, so every placement is a target.

**how i built it**

\- first version came from Nanogram, the app where you make games by prompting. good enough to see if the idea was fun

\- after that i took it over myself and kept building with Claude Code (Opus 4.8), plus a bit of Codex (GPT)

\- before adding features i studied other games in the genre to see what's common, like shops, daily rewards and art style, so i only built what players actually expect

**what AI got wrong**

as usual AI kept adding a bunch of extra stuff, like text indications everywhere. and every game it makes has the same generic art style. so most of my work was making it follow the specific art style i wanted and cutting features down to only what's really needed. (keep it simple, stupid😅)

it's on android, in pre-registration right now, full release early november. can't be played yet but you can pre-register and get it on launch day

Pre-register on Google Play: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.maziminds.climbandbite](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.maziminds.climbandbite)

also i am thinking of making more promotional content like those reels and short from Chess game where with each move it shows some memes and funny clips.

would love feedback on the trailer
